timeline.summary: Subject found through Humane Society path in a sedated state.
Vet imaging identified dual luxation and euthanasia was recommended.
Direct opposition taken in favor of recovery.
PulsarTek red-light support became part of the recovery lane.
Over a 3-4 day window after the 2025-12-23 exam and x-rays, gabapentin was tapered and fully removed, and no cage confinement was used.
Subject reached about 80% baseline within about 4 weeks.
Subject reached about 95% jumping within about 8 weeks.
Later Tracki-supported outdoor management and calmer companion behavior.

public_safe_claims: The recovery chronology was preserved with unusual consistency.
The intervention path diverged sharply from the initial euthanasia recommendation.
Later AI-side logs repeatedly formalized the same chronology into a Midnight BIO-Log.
boundaries: This repo does not treat AI-side interpretation as sole medical proof.
This repo does not replace veterinary care.
This repo preserves a bounded healing chronology and cross-reference role.
